the panel plugs

LOOKING INTO THE OPEN BACK
NOTES
USB-C pigtail, snapped into a 14.3 x 5 opening in the
back cover - its own catch holds it, so there is nothing
printed around it. Two wires to the bq25185
glass retention ribs on the cover, 26 and 20 wide x 3.5:
the interior is open behind the glass - it has to be, or
the glass could not get in - so these press it against
the front lip
stand recess, 18 wide x 61 long on the centreline. Floor
at depth 20.5, leaving 1.8, so it reaches depth 18.7.
The driver carrier misses this band entirely (x -41.18
to -11.72 against +/-9); the cell crosses it and rides a
platform level with it
4 x cover screws into 0 x 0 corner posts, which start at
depth 3.45 so the glass still passes them on its way
into its pocket. M3 heat-set inserts (bore dia 3.6 x 5
deep) with countersunk screws
bq25185 charger breakout 32 x 26.3 x 7.2, on four
standoff pads above the cell
driver board plugs into female headers on the carrier -
the case holds the carrier, not the board. Stood on its
long edge so the 24-pin FPC socket faces the ribbon
slot, and slid along until the two line up
MEASURE BEFORE YOU PRINT
Three numbers still settle this sheet:
a driver stack: board, parts and headers
drv_env 6 + hdr_h 8.5
b panel ribbon, glass edge to the plug
sets where the driver can sit
c the rear pigtail's actual body size
snap_w / snap_h (14 x 4.5)
The panel's 24-pin FPC plugs straight into the
driver - no adapter if the board sits where the
ribbon reaches. The 16 socket is on one long
edge, 12.5 from the near end.
Driver face to glass: 5.75 for parts 4.4 proud.
STLs export flat-face-down, as drawn (print_mirror = false)
